---
title: "Semiconductor Geopolitics"
description: "Chips, fabs, supply chains, and the geopolitics of semiconductor manufacturing"
toc: true
toc-depth: 2
---

Semiconductors sit at the intersection of technology, economics, national security, trade, and industrial policy. This page brings together my work on chip supply chains, India's semiconductor strategy, and the geopolitics of technological interdependence.

::: {.topic-hero}
::: {.topic-hero-card}
### Start here

[*When the Chips Are Down: A Deep Dive into a Global Crisis*](../books.html#when-the-chips-are-down-a-deep-dive-into-a-global-crisis) explains how semiconductors became a meta-critical technology and why chip supply chains now shape geopolitics.
:::

::: {.topic-hero-card}
### Live tracker

The [India Semiconductor Manufacturing Tracker](https://fabs.pranaykotas.com) monitors India's fabs, ATMP/OSAT units, compound semiconductor projects, milestones, investment, slippage, and technical complexity.
:::
